title: OmniFlow AI Enterprise Architecture Specification Module #1
content: Module 1 provides mission-critical enterprise capabilities for high-throughput AI workloads. The architecture implements stateless API routing, token-bucket rate limiting, and exact/semantic caching layers. When handling distributed agent workflows, intermediate states are committed to transactional checkpoints enabling time-travel inspection, automated retries, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Hybrid search combines dense vector embeddings with sparse BM25 lexical frequencies via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60), delivering sub-50ms P95 query latencies across enterprise knowledge repositories.

The architecture implements stateless API routing, token-bucket rate limiting, and exact/semantic caching layers. When handling distributed agent workflows, intermediate states are committed to transactional checkpoints enabling time-travel inspection, automated retries, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Hybrid search combines dense vector embeddings with sparse BM25 lexical frequencies via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60), delivering sub-50ms P95 query latencies across enterprise knowledge repositories.
